forbidden_semantic_inputs: commit messages/diffs/file snippets or unrelated metadata exposed only while resolving repository head
policy.feedback_use: mechanical self-local QC only; never infer novelty/relevance/acceptance/ranking/preferred mechanism
policy.own_state_resolution: LATEST/STATE first; otherwise newest source-qualified role-local checkpoint by repository chronology; minimum predecessor chain; quarantine accidental stale/cross-role observability reads. Role-local state is evidence/continuation input, never authority for the current DESIRED_STATE control revision or current evaluation config revision.
policy.scope_guard: never broaden evidence beyond tested scope
policy.continuation: open-ended; checkpoints/findings are never global completion; maintain nonempty frontier and exact next action until hard runtime/tool termination
policy.receipt_rule: write immutable own receipt only; never read aggregate ledger or other receipts. Every receipt/checkpoint must explicitly include bootstrap_valid and bind the actual frozen DESIRED_STATE parsed control_revision plus Git blob SHA and the actual frozen evaluation config parsed config_revision plus Git blob SHA. Parse revisions only from those exact frozen file bodies and obtain blob identities only from their exact file responses. Never copy either authority revision from LATEST, checkpoint filenames, prior continuation text, inferred future revisions, main SHA, or another artifact. If a claimed revision/blob does not equal the exact frozen file or either identity is unverifiable, set bootstrap_valid=false and diagnostic_only=true; it cannot count as positive Phase-1/parity evidence.
policy.control_freshness: Obtain note main SHA only via Git ref-object lookup such as refs/heads/main or equivalent SHA-only response; never use generic commit/search/branch payloads for head freshness. At H1 fetch sanitized DESIRED_STATE and this exact role config, parse their revisions from those bodies, and freeze both path/revision/blob identities. Repeat SHA-only head lookup before the first substantive semantic read; if either authoritative identity changed, restart bootstrap. The first own-state/public-source semantic read is the semantic-freeze barrier. AFTER THAT BARRIER DO NOT POLL OR COMPARE GENERIC MAIN HEAD BEFORE checker-v2 authoring, durable precommit/readback, checker persistence/readback, and the precommitted control executions. Generic main movement is not a work-termination signal. Complete that bounded evaluation work under the frozen authority tuple and consume no newer-head semantic content. Immediately before any current-Phase-1 positive acceptance/worker_pass/root-acceptance claim, perform one exact identity-only revalidation of DESIRED_STATE and automation_control/roles/evaluation.json. If both blobs still equal the frozen identities and no own-state CAS/input conflict exists, mark acceptance_authority_current=true. If either changed or is unverifiable, preserve completed checker/control artifacts as diagnostic evidence under the frozen tuple, set acceptance_authority_current=false/bootstrap_valid=false for current acceptance use, checkpoint exact continuation, and fresh-bootstrap next invocation; do not discard completed checker/control work and do not adopt newer semantics mid-run.

authority_order: exact frozen DESIRED_STATE current Phase-1 assignment and safety boundary
exact frozen current evaluation role config
current_assignment_precedence_contract.rule: Current frozen repository control defines the active Phase-1 procedure. Prior role-local exact_continuation remains preserved historical evidence and a scientific frontier, but a prior procedural step that conflicts with current repository control must be recorded as stale_conflicting_continuation and must not be executed. This supersession is procedural only: never erase or weaken prior scientific findings, tested scope, evidence/provenance rules, CLEAN isolation, anti-stop, checkpoint/resume, failure recovery, or substantive base-role restoration metadata.
current_assignment_precedence_contract.known_stale_conflict_class: Any prior evaluation continuation requiring generic post-semantic-freeze main-SHA polling or immediate semantic termination solely because generic main advanced before checker-v2/precommitted controls complete conflicts with config9 and is non-authoritative.

bootstrap_provenance_contract.root_revision_source: parse control_revision from the exact frozen automation_control/DESIRED_STATE.json body
bootstrap_provenance_contract.root_blob_source: exact Git file/blob identity returned for that frozen DESIRED_STATE path
bootstrap_provenance_contract.config_revision_source: parse config_revision from the exact frozen automation_control/roles/evaluation.json body
bootstrap_provenance_contract.config_blob_source: exact Git file/blob identity returned for that frozen evaluation config path
forbidden_revision_sources: inference from main SHA or time
bootstrap_provenance_contract.local_metadata_mismatch_rule: If role-local state claims a different current authority revision than the exact frozen root/config bodies, preserve that local state as scientific/history input but quarantine the mismatched authority metadata, set stale_local_authority_metadata_detected=true, and never propagate the mismatched number into new LATEST/checkpoint/receipt authority fields.

postfreeze_authority_identity_contract.accidental_generic_head_poll_rule: If a SHA-only generic main-head observation nevertheless occurs after semantic freeze and before checker/control completion, record postfreeze_generic_head_poll_breach=true but DO NOT terminate bounded checker/precommit/control work and DO NOT adopt newer semantics. The breach makes any positive acceptance claim from that invocation diagnostic-only unless the current config explicitly permits otherwise; completed checker/control artifacts remain reusable evidence. Only exact frozen-authority blob mismatch/unverifiability or an own-state CAS/input conflict may stop/defer semantic work.
postfreeze_authority_identity_contract.invalid_termination_kind: postfreeze_main_drift or freshness_stop based only on generic main SHA advancement with no exact frozen-authority mismatch is not a valid semantic termination under config9.
postfreeze_authority_identity_contract.acceptance_revalidation_barrier: Immediately before any positive Phase-1/worker/root acceptance claim, verify only the two frozen path-to-blob identities using SHA/path/blob-only transport.
postfreeze_authority_identity_contract.allowed_after_freeze: role-local/public semantic work under the frozen tuple; role-local current-blob/CAS/readback writes; one identity-only authority revalidation at the acceptance-publication barrier
postfreeze_authority_identity_contract.forbidden_after_freeze: generic head-drift polling as a termination gate before checker/control completion; newer-head authority file bodies or semantics; commit messages/diffs; other-role configs/receipts/state; O/downstream semantics
postfreeze_authority_identity_contract.acceptance_current_when: both frozen authority blobs are unchanged at the publication barrier, bootstrap provenance exactly matches the frozen files, no own-state CAS/input conflict requires reconstruction, checker precommit order is valid, and no procedural barrier breach has been classified as acceptance-invalidating
postfreeze_authority_identity_contract.diagnostic_only_when: either authority identity is mismatched or unverifiable at publication barrier, receipt provenance does not match the frozen files, checker precommit order is violated, a postfreeze generic-head procedural breach occurred before checker completion, or own-state conflict makes the claimed execution lineage ambiguous

required_order: freeze exact root/config tuple; parse revisions from those exact bodies; validate bootstrap
resolve own role-local state and explicitly quarantine any stale authority metadata or procedural continuation that conflicts with current frozen control
durably precommit checker identity plus Control A/B/C oracles and exact-readback
first checker execution on precommitted controls
only then emit any current positive acceptance claim
checker_v2_execution_order_contract.on_forbidden_poll: continue bounded checker work under frozen semantics, mark procedural breach, suppress current positive acceptance, and persist completed artifacts rather than stopping
checker_v2_execution_order_contract.self_or_other_worker_main_writes_do_not_: Only exact root/config identity change at acceptance revalidation can make the completed run ineligible for current positive acceptance; generic main drift alone cannot terminate bounded checker work.

policy.connector_discovery_read_only: Discover connector/tool/schema capability only through non-mutating schema/list/discovery and read-only lookup. Never create/update/delete/move a branch, ref, file, PR, issue, release, workflow or external resource as a noop/test/probe. A connector mutation is allowed only when required by substantive evaluation work and confined to the authorized evaluation state/output or own receipt destinations with CAS/readback.
policy.repository_write_boundary: Authorized writes are confined to research_workers_clean_g1/evaluation/ role-local state/output pointers and automation_control/receipts/evaluation/ immutable receipts. Temporary/noop branches or refs and mutations outside those destinations are forbidden.

migration.reason: The first durable config8 execution still terminated solely on generic post-freeze main drift before checker-v2 authoring/execution and propagated control_revision23 even though the exact DESIRED_STATE at its recorded semantic-freeze commit parsed as control_revision22. Its preserved role-local continuation still instructed 'after each acceptance-sensitive step' generic SHA recheck and immediate drift stop, contradicting current repository control. Config9 therefore makes repository-control precedence over conflicting prior procedural continuation explicit, hardens authority revision provenance to exact root/config bodies, and converts any accidental generic post-freeze head poll into a nonterminal procedural breach so useful checker work continues while positive acceptance remains fail-closed.
migration.rollback_condition: Only if config9 erases or weakens preserved scientific findings/base semantics, broadens CLEAN inputs, consumes newer-head semantics, permits positive acceptance with mismatched/unverifiable authority provenance, executes checker-v2 before durable precommit/readback, or violates repository write boundaries. Never restore the stale generic-head-abort behavior as an active Phase-1 procedure; if rollback is required, increment again and preserve the anti-starvation/provenance invariants.
